chapters.title: Build in rhythm
chapters.text: Welcome to Liturgy, a workspace for teams seeking to build technology through prayer, discernment, and service to their neighbours.

captions.text: Welcome to Liturgy, a workspace for teams seeking to build technology through prayer, discernment, and service to their neighbours.

chapters.title: A shared way of working
chapters.text: The public introduction brings the purpose into focus. Our process forms our team, so the rhythm of our work deserves the same care as the things we build.

captions.text: The public introduction brings the purpose into focus.

chapters.title: Discover · Discern · Develop · Demonstrate
chapters.text: The four D cycle moves from Discover to Discern, Develop, and Demonstrate. Checklists give each transition a visible boundary, inviting teams to prepare together before moving forward.

captions.text: The four D cycle moves from Discover to Discern, Develop, and Demonstrate.

chapters.title: Keep the ritual
chapters.text: Inside Develop, the board connects practical delivery with the five R loop: Request, Receive, Review, Render, and Rejoice. Each movement makes space for attention, action, and thanksgiving.

captions.text: Inside Develop, the board connects practical delivery with the five R loop: Request, Receive, Review, Render, and Rejoice.

chapters.title: Take the overview with you
chapters.text: The product overview has downloaded successfully as a PDF. It gives the team a shared introduction to discuss before beginning a project together.

chapters.title: Enter the workspace
chapters.text: The sign in link opens the working application. In the next demonstration, we will follow a seeded project and see the rhythm enforced through real changes.

chapters.title: Build with care
chapters.text: Liturgy invites us to connect what we build with how we serve. Let prayer shape our attention, discernment guide our choices, and gratitude accompany the work.
